# Brennen Green

> Brennen Green makes tools for people who make games and films. Today that means developer relations at Xbox; before that, tech art and engineering at DreamWorks Animation and Blizzard Entertainment, and engineering at Twitch and Intel.

Brennen studied computer science at the University of Kentucky, specializing in computer graphics and mathematics. This site is Brennen's home page and writing.

## About

- [Home](https://www.brennengreen.dev/): introduction and where Brennen has worked
- [Resume](https://www.brennengreen.dev/resume.md): work history, projects and education, in Markdown

## Writing

- [The Future of this Website](https://www.brennengreen.dev/blog/what-even-goes-here-anymore/): Sep 28, 2026. I've struggled in the agentic era deciding how / what my personal website should be.
- [Mandelbrot Fractals in OpenGL](https://www.brennengreen.dev/blog/posts/1/): May 15, 2020. A Mandelbrot Fractal is a fractal from the Mandelbrot Set, in this article we'll discuss rendering the fractals in version 330 of the OpenGL Core Profile
